body.name: normalizedCutsZero
body.space: a finite list of affine tangent maps on \(\mathbb R^d\)
body.def: For each \(\psi(p)=\alpha_{\psi}^{\prime}p+\beta_{\psi}\in\mathscr L_0\), record the sign of \(\psi(p_0)\). Cuts with nonzero base sign are frozen to that sign. For cuts with \(\psi(p_0)=0\), form \(a_{\psi}=B^{\prime}\alpha_{\psi}\), record \(a_{\psi}=0\) as a fixed tie, and otherwise clear denominators, divide by the integer greatest common divisor, orient by the first nonzero entry, and delete duplicates. The surviving active tangent list is \(\overline{\mathscr L}_0\).
body.role: scale-invariant active geometry that is meaningful for every local direction
